pw_double_many: {0} warnings turned out safe after a second look
pw_where_hybrid: Most calls were checked on this phone, online only when unsure
pw_where_on_device: Most calls were checked on this phone
pw_checked_hybrid: Checked on this phone, online only when unsure
ds_what_calmed: A warning came up, but the final check found the call safe.

reason_money: Asked for your OTP or money
reason_impersonation: Claims to be police, a bank or the government
reason_bert: The conversation as a whole sounds like a scam
reason_earlier: Warning signs earlier in the call
reason_no_lines: Ended before any line was checked
dash_empty: No calls yet. Try a practice call from Home.
ins_over_time_info_day: Each bar is one day. The colours show safe calls, calls that needed care, and scams.
ins_over_time_info_week: Each bar is one week. The colours show safe calls, calls that needed care, and scams.
ins_why_info: The main reason behind each warning or scam, most common first.
ins_signs_info: How many calls had each kind of warning sign. One call can have more than one.
ins_trend_info: The average risk of your calls over time. Above the yellow line needs care; above the red line looks like a scam.
ins_hours_info: When the calls that needed care, or were scams, came in.
ins_double_info: When a call ends, ScamGuard checks the whole call once more. Some warnings turn out safe.
ins_where_info: Most accurate: checked online. Balanced: on this phone, online only when unsure. Most private: only on this phone.
ins_answers_info: What you told ScamGuard after calls. These stay on this phone.
ins_length_info: Each dot is one call: further right is longer, higher up is riskier.
det_not_reached: Could not be checked again at the end
det_gone: This call is no longer saved.
det_no_scores: No scores were saved for this call.
det_circle: The circle marks the riskiest moment
a11y_risk_chart: Risk during the call: {0} points, highest {1}
a11y_double: Double-checked warnings: {0} confirmed, {1} turned out safe
